lessons.trigger: Creating, renaming or routing development agent instruction files
lessons.boundary: Does not rename the root AGENTS.md or unrelated application directories
lessons.defect: The initial layout used one role folder containing AGENTS.md; the user requested distinct filenames instead of a folder per agent.
lessons.cause: The initial design used nested role directories without an explicit flat-file naming convention.
evidence: User correction in this conversation: instead of having folder for each agent have a different name based on what they do.
Current convention and routes: AGENTS.md; role files: agents/<role>-agent.md.
lessons.prevention: Keep agent playbooks directly in agents/ as <role>-agent.md and update all routing references after a rename.
lessons.regression: Reject agents/<role>/AGENTS.md and missing routed files; accept existing flat role files while retaining root AGENTS.md.

lessons.trigger: Changing explanation retries, fallback behavior or orchestrator error routing
lessons.boundary: Does not authorize prose repair of structural data, missing evidence or portfolio constraint failures
lessons.defect: Earlier responsibility descriptions separately described template fallback and final error after retries, leaving their combined ordering ambiguous.
lessons.cause: The evidence and compliance sections described retry outcomes separately instead of sharing one explicit sequence.
evidence: The ambiguity was identified while adding the workflow in this conversation; docs/agent-responsibilities.md and docs/architecture.md were aligned.
Canonical bounded sequence: docs/agents-workflow.md, Runtime workflow to implement.
lessons.prevention: Use one initial explanation plus two repair generations total, then one deterministic fallback checked by the same gate; structural failures stop immediately.
lessons.regression: When runtime code exists, exhaust both citation and wording failures together and confirm the shared limit; also confirm an initially valid result needs no repair and structural failure invokes none.

lessons.trigger: Changing monthly rebalancing or relying on saved portfolio metrics
lessons.boundary: Synthetic accounting checks do not establish corrected real-market results
lessons.defect: The monthly backtest discarded the price change between the previous month's last close and the new month's first close.
lessons.cause: Each month purchased new units using the old portfolio value without first marking existing units at the new close.
evidence: Review fixture: a synthetic asset doubling across the boundary returned 10000 monthly versus 20000 with buy-and-hold.
tests/test_portfolio_regressions.py: boundary gain/loss, two-asset accounting and flat-price control.
lessons.prevention: Value existing units at the new close before rebalancing and invalidate generated validation results after calculation-method changes.
lessons.regression: Replay boundary gains/losses, a flat-price control and hand-computable two-asset rebalancing.

verification.scope: Offline synthetic and SDK adapter tests; private CSV integration skipped; risk.py remains a stub.

lessons.trigger: Building or explaining a final portfolio-fit verdict
lessons.boundary: A passing historical assessment is not a future-risk guarantee or legal suitability finding
lessons.defect: Forbidden crypto could return outside_profile=false because the verdict omitted crypto permission and crypto/gold caps.
lessons.cause: The capped branch enforced constraints that validate() omitted from the aggregate checks.
evidence: Review fixture with fabricated passing metrics accepted low-band BTC 1% while the capped branch removed it.
tests/test_portfolio_regressions.py: three-band forbidden-crypto cases, combined crypto cap, GLD cap and valid exact-cap control.
lessons.prevention: Combine every required rule into the verdict and supply profile permission flags explicitly; expose failed checks to the explanation agent.
lessons.regression: Forbidden holdings must conflict even with flat prices; a permitted exactly-at-cap allocation must pass.

verification.scope: Synthetic policy/control cases; no real-market result claims.

lessons.trigger: Transforming proposals or explaining feasible additions and adjusted alternatives
lessons.boundary: An invalid or unfundable request differs from an evaluable profile conflict; conditional maxima cannot be combined
lessons.defect: An oversized addition created negative bond weights, an unknown ticker appeared to pass unchanged, and a capped 5% TSLA candidate reported max_allowed=20.
lessons.cause: Funding/input preconditions were missing and the maximum search validated already-capped trials instead of actual trial additions.
evidence: Review fixtures: TSLA +100 produced XBB.TO=-0.25; an unknown ticker returned outside_profile=false; TSLA +20 returned max_allowed=20 after being capped to 5%.
tests/test_portfolio_regressions.py: invalid requests, safe unchanged/exact-cap controls, uncapped maximum search and no-feasible-maximum case.
lessons.prevention: Reject malformed/unfundable requests with structured status; preserve raw and adjusted outcomes separately; search uncapped trials and return null if no feasible trial exists.
lessons.regression: Reject negative-weight and unknown requests; on flat fixtures TSLA's low-band maximum is 5 additional points, not 20; verify unchanged and at-cap controls.

verification.scope: Discrete whole-point synthetic allocation/search checks; no AWS calls or profile regeneration.

lessons.trigger: Moving datasets or changing active price filenames and reference-portfolio inputs
lessons.boundary: A folder or filename correction does not authorize changing allocation policy, substituting tickers or regenerating private data
lessons.defect: After the dataset move the loader still expected prices_daily.csv; the user clarified the replacement name. Loading the replacement exposed two failing legacy dataset tests because six reference tickers are absent.
lessons.cause: Runtime defaults and documentation retained the starter layout and assumed that the replacement dataset contained the saved profile universe.
evidence: User correction: prices_daily was changed to historiques_actifs_2011.csv; actual disk filename is dataset/historique_actifs_2011.csv.
Observed header preserves date,ticker,adj_close,currency. Dataset inventory found AGG, CNQ.TO, JPM, SPY, XBB.TO and XIU.TO absent from saved profile holdings.
Initial renamed-file replay: tests/test_engine.py::test_robert_tsla_20 and test_robert_base_metrics failed; docs/DATA.md records the compatibility issue.

Subsequent user change: active file is now dataset/prices_daily.csv with ticker,date header order. Actual first row is AAPL,2016-01-08; loading by column names reads both correctly. Current inventory is 57,560 rows and 102 tickers with a median seven-day observation gap; earlier inventory evidence above describes the preceding snapshot.
lessons.prevention: Resolve canonical paths through the storage adapter, inspect actual filenames/schema and compare required tickers before relying on saved real-data assertions. Keep numerical regression controls independent of local data. Select CSV fields by header name rather than position; test both ticker/date orders and re-check coverage/frequency when inputs are replaced.
lessons.regression: Replay renamed CSV loading, default paths from a different working directory, missing-holding MISSING_INFO and an all-flat synthetic reference-build control; skip legacy real-data verdicts explicitly only when their required universe is unavailable.
